system.description:
Touch; 10ft-radius, 20ft-tall circle fixed at that point for 10 minutes per level.

  • Choose Good, Evil, Lawful or Chaotic: creatures of that alignment cannot enter it or make melee attacks into it, summoned ones cannot enter, and creatures inside are immune to their charm and possession.
  • Ends for a creature if it attacks out.
  • Requires holy water or powdered silver and iron worth 10 gp, consumed.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Wizard, Cleric, Paladin, Spellblade
